decision_rule: Latest forecast published by 09:50 UK local time on D-1 (DST-aware)

features.forecast_mw: Official forecast for the hour, latest published by the cutoff (MW)
features.lead_hours: Hours between that forecast's publication and the target hour
features.hour_uk: UK clock hour of the target hour (0-23)
features.forecast_revision_mw: Change versus the previous forecast run for the same hour (MW)
features.forecast_spread_mw: Std-dev of all forecasts for the hour published in the 24 h before the cutoff (MW)
features.forecast_ramp_mw: Forecast change from the previous hour in the same run (MW)
features.forecast_day_mean_mw: Mean forecast over the delivery day (MW)
features.latest_actual_mw: Most recent actual generation already published at the cutoff (MW)
features.recent_error_mw: Mean day-ahead forecast error over the last 24 h known at the cutoff (MW)
